query:
SELECT id, address::TEXT as "address!",
           hostname, assigned_to,
           GREATEST(
               COALESCE(similarity(hostname, $1), 0),
               COALESCE(similarity(assigned_to, $1), 0)
           ) as "sim!"
           FROM ip_addresses
           WHERE hostname % $1
              OR assigned_to % $1
              OR address::TEXT LIKE '%' || $1 || '%'
           ORDER BY "sim!" DESC
           LIMIT 10
